A 15: explain once; asking purpose = declining; not_verified / declined

A 38: text message sentence
A 39: already paid
A 40: dispute
A 41: restructuring
A 42: human
A 43: scam
A 44: cannot answer

A: Brief A never uses add_note (overridden by Brief B)
A 47: goodbye before close_call
B 1: one to three products
B 2: state every product before asking
B 3: band/deadline per product
B 4: ask all today once, then product by product
B 5: attempts per product
